Company Description
  
  
Techland is one of the biggest video game companies in Poland, with over 30 years of experience in the gaming industry. From our studios in Wrocław and Warsaw, we’ve built an international team of more than 500 talented professionals, all dedicated to pushing the boundaries of game development.
  
  
We’re known for creating iconic franchises like Call of Juarez and the zombie genre-defining Dying Light, which has been played by over 45 million players worldwide. With a focus on open-world action, storytelling, and community engagement, we’re committed to delivering unforgettable experiences to our players.
  
  
We’re constantly striving to improve, innovate, and take on new challenges. With ambitious plans for the future, we’re looking for passionate people to be part of this exciting journey.
  
  
Job Description
  
  
Techland is looking for a talented and experienced Level Artist to join one of our teams in Wrocław or Warsaw. You will help to create amazing environments the players will be exploring and admiring. You will be moving mountains, raising cities and breathing life into in-game locations thanks to aesthetically pleasing composition and clever use of light and detail.
  
  
**Your daily tasks:**  
Participating in the creation of ideas and plans for a locations/levels.
  
  
Setting the rough geometry of locations (terrain shape, buildings, interior walls),
  
  
Finishing locations and cutscenes with existing meshes and decals.
  
  
Lighting locations and cutscenes to enhance the mood and to help direct gameplay.
  
  
Optimizing locations.
  
  
Collaboration with Level Designers (responsible for gameplay), Concept Artists, 2D/3D Artists and other people involved in creating game locations.
  
  
Working using a proprietary editor.
  
  
Taking care of a particular part of the game (i.e. a large part of the environment).
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
At least 3 years of experience in level design or lighting video games levels.
  
  
At least one shipped AAA title.
  
  
Very good command of English.
  
  
Passion for games and knowledge of the gaming industry from the player’s perspective.
  
  
Ability to express ideas verbally and through quick sketches.
  
  
Excellent teamwork skills.
  
  
An eye for real-world and game references.
  
  
Familiarity with 2D or 3D graphics suites (Adobe Photoshop, 3DS Max/Blender).
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**What we offer:**  
**A wide array of benefits:** private medical care, life insurance, pro-health campaigns, gifts for different occasions.
  
  
An outstanding work atmosphere in a highly-skilled team of professionals, with flexible working hours, no dress code, and full support of the dedicated HR Business Partner.
  
  
A constant stream of company newsletters, PR & project updates so you will always be in the know.
  
  
**Many opportunities for personal development:** a dedicated development budget for each employee, extra two paid days for training and CSR, stable career paths, extensive internal and external training, and financing of English and Polish language classes.
  
  
State-of-the-art offices filled with chillout zones, a fully equipped kitchen, a gym (Wrocław office), and a free car park (Warsaw limited amount of space).

**We are looking for a Range Creator/ 3D Artist for a global company in Malmö. Start is ASAP, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is full-time and 100% onsite in Malmö.**

**Assignment/task:**

The person will be embedded in one of the team creating the range information and rules used by the planners.

**Level of role:**

Junior to medium.

**Background:**

Range Experience (REX) delivers solutions to all company retailers spanning over +50 markets worldwide and over +400 stores and company digital channels. All solutions are made to help customers and co-workers in all customer meetings, from a mobile phone to the largest company store in the world.

Being a range creator means working with data and behaviour for the company range (the products) when used in our 3D planning tools. This includes defining what building rules different products have, how they behave in a room setting and in relations to other products.

Products are defined in a web-based Range Management System (RMS) and as a range creator, you will in that RMS to create new products and update previously added products. The building rules are sometimes complex, and it’s up to the range creator to set up the structure to solve these complex building rules to make the range behave correctly in our applications. It will require discussions and dialogues within the range team, but also with other teams, like the 3D platform team.

In your role as Range Creator, a **developer background is not needed**, but it might help you getting started faster.

**The scope of the role is to assist the company in:**

Besides the range creation task, the daily work includes taking part in the team´s planning, collaboration and cross-team alignment activities.

**Desired knowledge, experience, competence, skills, etc:**

No specific prior experience is required, but a structure mindset and a quick-learning capacity is imperative with excellent teamwork ability.

**Following competences to be fulfilled:**

* Good communication skills, especially in English.
* Analytic and problem-solving mindset.
* Structured way of working
* Quick learner
* Teamwork and collaboration

**Following competences preferred to be fulfilled:**

* Enjoy solving problems and create efficiency in the development.
* Self-development skills to keep up to date with fast-changing trends.
* Former relevant retail experience

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Malmö through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 1 year limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Malmö.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

**3D Artist – Dedicated Client Team**
=====================================

We're looking for a 3D Artist to join a dedicated Seventy team working with one of our key clients: an international, bootstrapped and fast-growing consumer technology company. You'll bring their products to life in still and moving images for upcoming product launches, working side by side with the client and our creative leads.

**THE ROLE**
------------

This role is fully focused on one client for a period of one year. As part of the core team, you'll own the product imagery for upcoming launches, from hero renders and packshots to product animations. It's a hands-on, fast-paced role where you take the work from CAD file to finished assets without compromising on craft or quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Create photorealistic product renders, packshots and hero images for launches, e-commerce and retail
* Produce product animations and motion content for launch films, social and digital channels
* Build and art-direct 3D scenes – lighting, materials, cameras and compositions that make the products look their best
* Collaborate directly with the client, Seventy's creative leads and designers to turn briefs into launch-ready assets
* Use AI tools where it makes sense to make the workflow as efficient as possible and identify new opportunities where AI can raise quality and creativity

YOUR PROFILE

### **You are…**

* A skilled 3D artist with a strong eye for lighting, materials and composition, and a portfolio of high-end product visualization
* Experienced in creating both stills and animation, from single hero shots to full product sequences
* Comfortable working from CAD and engineering data, and preparing models for rendering
* Experienced and comfortable using AI tools in your 3D workflow, and curious about new ways to push the work further
* Confident working directly with clients, understanding what they want and need
* Self-driven, taking initiative and managing your own workflow to deliver on time
* Comfortable in an international environment, collaborating across markets and cultures

### **It's a plus if you have…**

* Experience from consumer electronics, tech or product launches
* Skills in compositing, post-production and colour grading
* Experience with real-time 3D, such as Unreal Engine

**GOOD TO KNOW**
----------------

* Tools: 3D software such as Cinema 4D or Blender, render engines such as Redshift or Octane, Adobe Creative Suite (incl. After Effects) and AI tools such as Gemini, Midjourney, Figma Weave and Google AI Studio
* Engagement: Dedicated to one client for 12 months
* Language: Fluent English is mandatory
* Place of work: Stockholm, Sweden. We work hybrid, but expect and encourage most of the work to be done together with the team in our Stockholm office
* Start: As soon as possible

**ABOUT US**
------------

Founded in 2012, Seventy Agency has been working with global brands for over a decade. From large corporations like Samsung, Ericsson and H&M to pioneering tech startups such as Nothing and Kustom, we bring together producers, strategists and creatives to build brands that make people feel, remember and buy.

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

We interview continuously and want to fill the role as soon as possible, so don't wait to send your application.

A strong portfolio is required. Attach your portfolio (or a link to your portfolio website) together with your application. Examples of product renders and product animations are especially welcome. Applicants who don't provide a portfolio are automatically disqualified.

### **We are Fatshark**

We are a critically acclaimed Swedish game development studio with about 200 experienced and skilled employees. We are most well-known for developing the Warhammer: Vermintide franchise, but have also helped develop a number of AAA titles and we launched the highly anticipated game Warhammer 40,000: Darktide.

We have grown quite a bit over the last few years, but we still embrace the same values that we started with. We want to build the best first person co-op games together, in an approachable, fun and passion-driven way.

### **The role**

Fatshark is seeking an experienced Level Artist to join our talented development team building an upcoming title in Unreal Engine 5.

A Level Artist at Fatshark serves as the bridge between design and art, shaping environments from early blockout to final, shippable quality with assets created by Environment Artists and layouts created by Level Designers.

You’ll collaborate closely with the Level Team, working side by side with Level Designers, Environment Artists, Lighting Artists, Technical Artists, Sound Designers, Concept Artists and the Art Director. Your work will be central to tying visual, gameplay and audio intentions together into a cohesive and atmospheric player experience.

You will be part of a highly motivated and talented team, so you will need to be driven, creative and flexible when meeting deadlines and handling unforeseen production challenges. At Fatshark, all members of the team take part in decision making. We are a small enough group to stay agile, yet big enough to realize ambitious ideas together.

As a Level Artist, your work will sit at the crossroads of art, design, gameplay and sound, so collaboration is key. You’ll rely on clear communication, the ability to give and receive feedback, and a willingness to iterate. Although your primary focus will be level art, there will be occasions where you support other areas such as prop setup, material adjustments or smaller polish tasks related to outsourcing or internal asset work.

**This is a 12-month temporary contract onsite at our office in Stockholm with the alternative option of working on a 12-month freelance basis.**

### **What you'll do**

* Collaborate with Level Designers to understand gameplay goals, layouts and flow
* Build levels using modular kits, props and environment assets provided by the Environment Art team
* Perform set dressing to create believable, visually compelling and gameplay-friendly spaces that help guide the player
* Work with Lighting Artists, Sound Designers and Concept Artists to reinforce mood, readability and atmosphere
* Ensure levels run smoothly on all target platforms by using efficient asset placement, lighting, occlusion and culling techniques
* Participate in playtesting and iterate on levels based on feedback from art, design, audio and QA
* Provide clear feedback to Environment Artists and request new assets when needed
* Help maintain level art guidelines and contribute to improvements in tools and workflows
* Partner with Technical Artists to develop materials, basic shaders, and non-destructive procedural pipelines and tools to maximize visual fidelity and iteration speeds

### **Required qualifications**

* More than 2 years of professional experience creating level art or environment art for real time 3D games on console or PC
* Experience working inside a game engine such as Unreal, Unity or a proprietary engine
* A strong artistic eye with an understanding of composition, lighting, form, structure and visual storytelling
* Ability to read and follow concept art, as well as improvise when needed
* Understanding of level performance constraints and memory budgets
* Experience with modular building, reusability and efficient scene construction
* Strong communication skills and high proficiency in English
* Ability to meet deadlines, handle multiple tasks and collaborate well with cross-discipline teams

3D Environment Artist & Level Designer

Applications are open please apply via - https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/scape/8a65fbf3-dc64-4917-9e06-1f2a79272d7f

ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote

* Level: Senior to lead
* Location: Remote, CET overlap
* Contract: Full time, long term

About us

We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft.

The project

Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same.

Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this.

About the role

We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer.

You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them.

The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team.

You report to the Art Director.

What you will do

Environment art

* Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit.
* Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts.
* Build modular kits that can be reused across levels.
* Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction.

Level design

* Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared.
* Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine.
* Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results.
* Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression.
* Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines.

What we are looking for

* Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development.
* Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish.
* Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts.
* A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final.
* Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity.
* Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it.
* Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials.
* Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning.
* Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team.

f04af22b530a4c3f8255.descripcion:
**Help us build the world of Northward.**

Northward is an open-world co-op adventure about sailing a scrappy ship through a cold northern archipelago, finding lost treasure, and working out how to send a fallen star home. Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AT1cON6KZPI

We're Yore & Yonder, a small game studio in Stockholm. Right now it's the two of us who founded it, plus a few freelancers we've worked with for years. The game is fully funded, and we're hiring two full-time people for the core team, a Generalist Game Artist and a Level & Quest Designer.

**What you'll do**

You'll model everything players see, from environments and props to creatures, characters and ships. You'll also draw icons, in-game 2D assets and concept art, and help with lighting, VFX, set dressing and level art.

The look is stylised low poly with exaggerated shapes. It's a cosy, slightly steampunky fairy tale with real danger in it. It has to run well on a Steam Deck. You'll work directly with Marcus, our creative director.

**You probably have**

* 3+ years making 3D art for games, or a portfolio that shows the same level
* finished, stylised work in your portfolio, shown in a game engine if you can
* a good eye for how a whole scene looks together
* experience with Blender
* experience getting assets into Unreal Engine
* good spoken and written English
* a love of games, and you still play a lot of them

Rigging and animation are a plus. A rigging and animation consultant handles the heavy work.

If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway.

**What's good, and what's hard**

* What you make will be all over the game. The core team will be four people, and our procedural tools put your models across a whole world.
* The game is already playable, and we have a clear roadmap.
* We run our own version of Unreal, so you can't always google your way out of a problem.

**The job**

Full-time, on-site, and permanent, with a six-month probationary period. We pay into an occupational pension and give you a wellness allowance. Our office is in Stockholm (Aspudden today, most likely Södermalm later). We work there most days, and if you need a day at home, take it. We'd love you to start in January, but we'll wait for the right person. You need to already have the right to work in Sweden, as we can't sponsor visas or help with moving.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn or email contact@yoreandyonder.com with "Generalist Game Artist" in the subject. Either way, make sure we get:

* a link to your portfolio (ArtStation or similar)
* your CV
* a few lines on why Northward

We read applications as they come in and want to fill the role before the end of the year, so don't wait for a deadline.

*COFFEE STAIN NORTH is a small game developer based in Stockholm that belongs to the Coffee Stain Group. Since the company was founded in 2013, we have grown to 38 employees and are now open to adding a couple of new friends!*
*Goat Simulator 3 is a third-person sandbox adventure developed by Coffee Stain North in which the player can live out their wildest dreams... as a goat. As an Environment Artist, you will create a wide range of environment assets, from foliage and organic nature to hard-surface, human-made structures. The role involves adapting your artistic style to fit different projects, with a focus on stylized and semi-realistic environments.
  
  
A key part of your work will be planning and creating modular asset sets for large and complex buildings and structures, finding smart and efficient ways to work with trim sheets, asset libraries, and reusable meshes. You'll also use sketches to communicate your ideas and plans for larger asset sets.
  
  
Your responsibilities will also include:
  
  

* Developing smart solutions for large meshes, including layered materials, detail normals, secondary UVs, and landscape materials.
* Taking ownership of your Environment Art pipeline, continuously looking for ways to improve performance, efficiency, and quality.
* Being proactive and independent in your work, finding the information and solutions you need to move tasks forward.
* Collaborating closely with Level Designers, Tech Artists, and other Artists to bring the game world to life.

**Your background**
To succeed in this role, we see that you have around 2+ years of professional experience creating 3D Environment Art for games, along with experience working with different pipelines and best practices across game projects. You've also been part of shipping at least one game and are comfortable working in Unreal Engine and Autodesk Maya or Blender.
  
  
We'd also like to see that you have:
  
  

* A portfolio showcasing both organic and hard-surface 3D models, as well as modular asset sets using trim sheets.
* A strong passion for creating great-looking game environments, with an understanding of how to balance visual quality with technical and time constraints.
* A proactive and independent approach to your work, combined with strong problem-solving and communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Bonus points if you have 2D art skills that can be applied to game environments, such as creating signs, billboards, posters, graffiti, or similar assets.

****Job Description:****
Zur Unterstützung beim Planungstool sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen
  
  
****Praktikanten (d/m/w) im Bereich 3D Game Artist/ 3D Modeler für eine Simulations- und Planungssoftware****
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum und möchtest die Arbeit eines Praktikanten (d/m/w) im Bereich 3D Game Artist/ 3D Modeler für eine Simulations- und Planungssoftware kennenlernen ? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns, wenn du uns beim Planungstool als Praktikant (d/m/w) unterstützt!
  
  

* Standort: Immenstaad am Bodensee
* Start: Ab März 2027
* Dauer: 6 Monate

****Dein Standort****
Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.
  
  
Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik - in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.
  
  
****Deine Vorteile****

* Attraktive Vergütung und ausgeglichene Work-Life-Balance bei einer 35-Stunden-Woche (Gleitzeit).
* I nternationales Umfeld mit der Möglichkeit, Kontakte in die ganze Welt zu knüpfen.
* Arbeit mit modernen/abwechslungsreichen Technologien.
* Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an der Generation Airbus Community zur Erweiterung des eigenen Netzwerks.

****Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten****

* Modellieren von game-ready 3D Modellen in Blender / Substance Painter.
* Korrekturen an fehlerhaften Modellen (z.B. Texturen / UV Mapping).
* Optimieren der 3D Modelle für die Verwendung in einer Game Engine (Unity).
* Highpoly Lowpoly Workflow anwenden.
* Einbinden der 3D Modell in Unity.
* Erweiterung oder Konzeptionierung der graphischen Bedienoberfläche.

****Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen****

* Eingeschriebener Vollzeitstudent (d/m/w) im Bereich Medieninformatik, Mediendesign, Gamedesign o.ä. oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung.
* Kenntnisse im Bereich 3D Modellierung (Blender, Substance Painter).
* Kenntnisse in Unity (optional).
* Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse.

**We are Fatshark**
We are a critically acclaimed Swedish game development studio with about 200 experienced and skilled employees. We are most well-known for developing the Warhammer: Vermintide franchise, but have also helped develop a number of AAA titles and we launched the highly anticipated game Warhammer 40,000: Darktide.
  
  
We have grown quite a bit over the last few years, but we still embrace the same values that we started with. We want to build the best first person co-op games together, in an approachable, fun and passion-driven way.
  
  
**The role**
Fatshark is seeking an experienced Level Artist to join our talented development team building an upcoming title in Unreal Engine 5.
  
  
A Level Artist at Fatshark serves as the bridge between design and art, shaping environments from early blockout to final, shippable quality with assets created by Environment Artists and layouts created by Level Designers.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with the Level Team, working side by side with Level Designers, Environment Artists, Lighting Artists, Technical Artists, Sound Designers, Concept Artists and the Art Director. Your work will be central to tying visual, gameplay and audio intentions together into a cohesive and atmospheric player experience.
  
  
You will be part of a highly motivated and talented team, so you will need to be driven, creative and flexible when meeting deadlines and handling unforeseen production challenges. At Fatshark, all members of the team take part in decision making. We are a small enough group to stay agile, yet big enough to realize ambitious ideas together.
  
  
As a Level Artist, your work will sit at the crossroads of art, design, gameplay and sound, so collaboration is key. You’ll rely on clear communication, the ability to give and receive feedback, and a willingness to iterate. Although your primary focus will be level art, there will be occasions where you support other areas such as prop setup, material adjustments or smaller polish tasks related to outsourcing or internal asset work.
  
  
**This is a 12-month temporary contract onsite at our office in Stockholm with the alternative option of working on a 12-month freelance basis.**
**What You'll Do**

* Collaborate with Level Designers to understand gameplay goals, layouts and flow
* Build levels using modular kits, props and environment assets provided by the Environment Art team
* Perform set dressing to create believable, visually compelling and gameplay-friendly spaces that help guide the player
* Work with Lighting Artists, Sound Designers and Concept Artists to reinforce mood, readability and atmosphere
* Ensure levels run smoothly on all target platforms by using efficient asset placement, lighting, occlusion and culling techniques
* Participate in playtesting and iterate on levels based on feedback from art, design, audio and QA
* Provide clear feedback to Environment Artists and request new assets when needed
* Help maintain level art guidelines and contribute to improvements in tools and workflows
* Partner with Technical Artists to develop materials, basic shaders, and non-destructive procedural pipelines and tools to maximize visual fidelity and iteration speeds

**Required Qualifications**

* More than 2 years of professional experience creating level art or environment art for real time 3D games on console or PC
* Experience working inside a game engine such as Unreal, Unity or a proprietary engine
* A strong artistic eye with an understanding of composition, lighting, form, structure and visual storytelling
* Ability to read and follow concept art, as well as improvise when needed
* Understanding of level performance constraints and memory budgets
* Experience with modular building, reusability and efficient scene construction
* Strong communication skills and high proficiency in English
* Ability to meet deadlines, handle multiple tasks and collaborate we
